title: The cardinal product block has exact covariance, Fisher and fourth-defect identities

composition.trial: Put independent K1676 coordinates on the K1677 whitened cardinal block, standard Gaussians on its orthogonal complement, then push forward by S_(g,N)^(1/2).
composition.covariance: The trial is centered with covariance exactly S_(g,N), hence the K1637 mean/covariance Bregman term A_N is zero.
composition.defect: Cumulant tensorization gives D_N=-2t^2L_N exactly, where L_N is K1677's packet fourth-mass sum.
composition.scope_guard: The identity is finite-cutoff and covariance matched; it does not assert stationarity before Haar averaging or identify the true variational coefficient.
